scripts.dev: npm run dev:ui & npm run dev:main
scripts.dev:ui: cross-env TARGET=ui NODE_ENV=development vite build --mode development -w
scripts.dev:main: cross-env TARGET=main NODE_ENV=development vite build --mode development -w
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:ui && npm run build:main && node -e "try{require('fs').rmSync('./dist/assets',{recursive:true,force:true})}catch(e){}"
